bullets.text: Minister Dr. K.G. Arunraj stated that TVK's victory in the by-elections is certain, and the office should monitor political reactions to this statement.
Power cuts are scheduled in areas like Thillai Ganga Nagar from 9 AM to 2 PM, so the office should alert local residents.
Migratory birds have started arriving in Chennai wetlands as the winter season begins, and the office should note this environmental update.
The Tiruvallur district administration strengthened surveillance on paddy movement following trader complaints at DPCs, and the office should track district updates.
Telangana IT Minister D. Sridhar Babu pitched a global capability centre hub and skill-centric curricula at the REACH 2026 conclave, which the portfolio team should review.

stories.title: Winged visitors from afar return to Chennai’s wetlands as migratory season begins
takeaways: Migratory bird species have started arriving at Chennai wetlands as winter approaches.
Nature enthusiasts and birdwatchers are recording early sightings across local water bodies.

stories.title: Surveillance strengthened on paddy movement in Tiruvallur
takeaways: Tiruvallur administration stepped up checks at direct procurement centres to stop trader exploitation.
Farmers complained that outside traders were unfairly dumping paddy bags into state procurement channels.

stories.title: Sridhar Babu pitches global capability centre hub for Telangana
takeaways: Telangana IT Minister D. Sridhar Babu advocated for skill-centric academic curricula at the REACH 2026 conclave.
The initiative aims to position the neighbouring state as a primary hub for global capability centres.
